source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.fruit: Nuts and cups 3–6 cm wide, largest among North Central Texas oaks in flora
morphology_documented.habitat: Stream bottoms, lower slopes and upland woods; in or near limestone, usually at least moderately drained

regional_flora_key_traits.leaves: Leaves deeply unevenly lobed, terminal leaf lobe much larger than others and rounded (key)
